Is very similar. Can you try patch from my issue?

I wish that pull request [##122993](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/122993) would finally be integrated. At least for me this fixes the temperature readings being divided by /5 without breaking those thermostats which show correct temperature without the PR.

I have several tuya thermostats from various manufacturers. A while ago breaking change was introduced to scale_value function in base.py (moved to entity.py with the recent update). So now devices from "proper" manufacturers shows correct temp, and from "wrong" ones - divided by 5 or so.

What fixed it for me and all my devices shows correct temp now:
Locate yours base.py i.e. /usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/tuya/base.py and change function to (count your spaces):
```
    def scale_value(self, value: float) -> float:
        """Scale a value."""
        return value * self.step / (10**self.scale)
```

review_comments:
Unfortunately, this change is not correct.

This occurrence is seen more often, and is generally caused by the device. Please contact Tuya support or the device manufacturer instead.

The currently calculation is correct (and as documented by Tuya). If we would merge this, we would break basically all other Tuya devices that have a numeric value communicated (which are a lot of them).

../Frenck
